newsitem.title: USA: Air Products to double WF6 capacity.
newsitem.headline: Air Products to double WF6 capacity.

text.p: Air Products and Chemicals Inc said Monday it will roughly double the tungsten hexafluoride (WF6) capacity of its Hometown, Pa., electronic specialty gas manufacturing facility to some 140,000 pounds per year to meet increased worldwide demand for the product by the semiconductor industry.
The new capacity will be available in the third quarter of this year, the company said.
WF6 is used in the manufacture of integrated circuits as a metalization source for the formation of tungsten plug interconnects between multiple layers in the devices.
Demand for the gas, driven by communication and consumer product applications, is expected to continue growing at double-digit rates.
